dfm_alerts.description: The BOM specifies 10 modules, but the CAD layout contains 14. Rail, clamp, attachment and electrical quantities cannot be released against conflicting array sizes.
dfm_alerts.fix: Choose the intended layout, then reconcile the module count and recalculate all mounting and electrical quantities.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: BOM quantities must match the released assembly drawing — standard manufacturing BOM control practice.

dfm_alerts.description: Rail alignment, module gaps and roof-edge margin lack a common datum and an installation inspection method. The specified gaps may conflict with the selected module's clamp zones.
dfm_alerts.fix: Issue a dimensioned roof layout with datums, measurement points, rail spans and the selected module's permitted clamp zones.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Module mounting must follow the manufacturer's installation instructions — IEC 61730-1 (PV module construction requirements).

dfm_alerts.description: Module, inverter, isolator and cable ratings are approximate or unspecified; string voltage, current and connector compatibility cannot be checked.
dfm_alerts.fix: Select exact manufacturer part numbers and issue a string diagram with temperature-corrected voltage, current, cable, isolator and connector checks.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: PV array electrical design must account for component ratings and string configuration — IEC 62548-1 (PV array design requirements).

dfm_alerts.description: The battery pack and battery inverter/charger have no defined electrical interface or operating architecture with the grid-tie inverter.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify an approved AC- or DC-coupled architecture, compatible equipment models, protection scheme and commissioning tests.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Power conversion equipment safety and installation interfaces require verification — IEC 62109-1 (PV power-converter safety).

dfm_alerts.description: The stationary battery has no specified installation location, enclosure, thermal clearance or ventilation provisions.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify a certified battery system and its installation location; document required clearances, ventilation, protection and compliance with the battery manufacturer's instructions.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Safety requirements for industrial lithium batteries — IEC 62619.

dfm_alerts.description: Solid product (424.3 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: on-site installation of bought-in modules, rails and inverter.
dfm_alerts.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

build_strategy.title: Module assembly
build_strategy.explanation: You design the product around bought-in, pre-certified modules (e.g. motor + driver, battery pack, radio module, heater + fan): your work is the architecture, the enclosure, the integration and the software; the factory assembles the modules into your parts. Faster and cheaper than designing every sub-system, and the modules' certifications carry part of the compliance.
customisable: Array layout, module choice, inverter and battery option
not_customisable: Certified PV modules, inverter, mounting system

entry_cost.source_or_assumption: Turnkey install cost of the solar design (5.59 kWp × 1.9 EUR/Wp turnkey residential (EU 2026 range 1.5-2.5 EUR/Wp))

build_strategy.certifications_note: Components carry their certifications; the installation follows national electrical rules (installer certification).
